info.title: em
info.description: em — the emlang CLI for .NET. Parses and lints emlang Event Model specs (*.em.yaml) with the reference toolchain's rule set and output format. Phase 1 commands: parse, lint, version, help.

commands.name: fmt
commands.description:
Format a YAML source file (use - for stdin, -w for in-place)
--keys short|long: override key style

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Lint a YAML source file for issues (use - for stdin)

commands.name: parse
commands.description: Parse a YAML source file and show structure (use - for stdin)

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to config file (default: .emlang.yaml, or EMLANG_CONFIG env)
